book.title: 林伯洛斯特的女孩
book.author: 吉恩·斯特拉顿-波特 (Gene Stratton-Porter)

special_risk_notes: Long public-domain novel with sustained dialogue, nature description, and period social context.
Character nicknames, moth terminology, and 1900s Midwestern social codes require consistency.

difficulty_factors: Long-form literary prose requires stable Chinese novel voice.
Nature and moth terminology recur across many chapters.
Reader-facing quality bar is raised by mandatory whole-chapter control loops and post-EPUB spot-check rounds.
pretranslation_estimate.difficulty_rationale: The book is a long public-domain novel rather than a technical text, but it mixes literary narration, dialogue, recurring insect terminology, and period social nuance. The main difficulty lies in maintaining natural zh-Hans novel prose while preserving factual and terminological precision across the whole book.

historical_reference.history_usage_note: No comparable publishable PASS metrics were available in the current repository snapshot.

model_recommendations.recommended_for: broad draft translation and terminology expansion
cost_control_notes: Use for broad drafting only after sample quality proves acceptable.
quality_risk_notes: Watch for term drift and semi-literal prose in emotional dialogue.

model_recommendations.recommended_for: chapter control, difficult passages, and final release QA
cost_control_notes: Reserve for difficult chapters, defect-family cleanup, and release-facing passes.
quality_risk_notes: Do not accept fluent but slightly stiff prose as final publication quality.

model_recommendations.recommended_for: independent long-context review and comparative QA
cost_control_notes: Prefer targeted comparative review over full duplicate passes.
quality_risk_notes: Require explicit issue rows and source-supported reasoning.

cost_quality_strategy: Use medium-tier drafting only when later expert review is guaranteed.
Escalate all recurring defect families to high-tier review.
Spend final tokens on whole-chapter control, post-EPUB family hunting, and release validation.

models_used.role: chapter control rebuild, defect-family audit, random spot-check revision, and release QA

post_translation_actual.variance_against_estimate: The initial auto-estimate overstated chapter count and domain spread, but the real workload remained high because all 25 chapters had to be rebuilt to the new full-chapter control template and the post-EPUB spot-check required two defect-family fix rounds before the final PASS seed.
lessons_for_future_estimates: Long novels with stable plot complexity can still become high-effort projects when the chapter-control template changes and every existing chapter record must be rebuilt.
Random spot-check should be budgeted for multiple seeds even when the first clean round has no blocking issues, because excellence-level prose may still require family-based cleanup.
Estimate target-style difficulty from release bar, not only from source complexity: literary zh-Hans publication quality pushes effort above ordinary faithful translation.
